geopolitics_summary: EU energy security concerns dominate: winter gas shortage fears drive strategic reserve discussions; Russia–Slovakia ties risk LNG supply disruption; emissions policy tensions between member states.

themes.headline: Von der Leyen proposes EU-wide strategic gas reserves amid winter shortage concerns
themes.why_it_matters: Bloc-level gas stockpiling would reduce winter supply risk and support TTF price stability. Direct support for forward curve; reduces tail risk of price spikes in Nov–Mar window.

themes.headline: Russia-Slovakia ties strengthening; Fico emerges as Putin's leading EU ally
themes.why_it_matters: Slovakia gateway for Russian gas; Fico proximity to Putin raises LNG import pressure on EU, widening TTF–HH spreads and reducing power curve hedging optionality.

themes.headline: EU leaders clash over energy pricing and budget at summit; Costa under fire
themes.why_it_matters: Member-state divisions on energy price interventions signal fragmented policy response, extending uncertainty on price caps, windfall taxes, and DA power spread intervention through winter.

themes.headline: France-Germany strike compromise on car emissions and Made-in-Europe sourcing
themes.why_it_matters: Removes roadblock to ETS-linked transport carbon rules; resolves near-term legislative risk for EU emissions trading curve; signals climate policy continuity for EUA forwards.

themes.headline: Brussels flags EU methane rule implementation failures; member states partly culpable
themes.why_it_matters: Enforcement delays on methane reporting and limits; if tightened, reduces gas supply visibility and could amplify leakage-driven TTF volatility; indirect EUA upside if tightening accelerates.

watchlist: EU winter gas supply updates and strategic reserve framework rollout (Nov–Dec).
Slovakia energy policy shifts under Fico; LNG contract renegotiation risk.
Next EU Council session on energy price interventions and caps (late Oct/Nov).
Methane rule enforcement tightening; impact on gas supply metrics and reporting.
